connector.name: MCP by pictify-io
connector.registryDescription: Generate images, GIFs, and PDFs from HTML, URLs, or templates - from your AI agent.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.pictify.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pictify-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
